text:
nina: quick note, saw divergence on magnet-13b-q3 when reinserting a short system prompt mid-generation
omar: details?
nina: model: magnet-13b-q3-int3hybrid, seq=32k, operation: generate 10k tokens, at t=4k inject another system message then continue. fp32 baseline matches, q3 run drifts near token ~4,120 (insertion/skip)
rachel: could be RoPE anchoring shift. any kernel flags (rotary rescale)?
nina: toggling rotary_rescale reduces incidence but doesn't eliminate. with rescale=false it's deterministic in my env.
omar: share minimal curl?
nina: pasted minimal repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"magnet-13b-q3","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"INIT SYS\n"},{"role":"user","content":"<very-long-user-chunk>"}] , "stream":false }'
# mid-run we programmatically insert {"role":"system","content":"REINJECT\n"} and continue
```
nina: quick canary logs: 
[2026-03-18T09:21:11Z] kv_slots_used: 1208
[2026-03-18T09:21:11Z] kv_anchor_pos: 0x1a3f -> 0x1a30 (delta -15)
[2026-03-18T09:21:11Z] top_token: " and" (actual) vs expected " or"

rachel: delta -15 is a tell. hypothesis: quant block packing rounded pointer arithmetic when writing small insertions, shifting RoPE base mapping for some heads.
omar: experiments to run: (1) pad reinjected system prompt to align pack boundary, (2) force re-anchor step after injection, (3) run with prefix_cache_disable=true to bypass KV replay. compare logits pre/post injection.
nina: tried (1) - padding to 64-byte boundary dropped failure rate a lot. (3) with prefix_cache_disable=true also eliminated the drift.
ci-bot: ci: magnet-13b-q3-rotaryfix canary image built (sha: dea1f3) and deployed to canary pool 3
omar: good signal. next: instrument canary with per-head phase checksum + top-10 logits snapshot around injection point. also add quant4 hybrid run for comparison.
rachel: if this is KV block allocation instability we should either make small-insert writes anchor-stable or always re-anchor after any midstream prompt insertion. add regression test that reinserts mid-generation.
nina: filing issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/ML-9853 (draft, attaching logs). will run multi-trial overnight on dedicated GPUs and post results.
omar: also tag eng-runtime and eng-sre to check allocator differences between containers vs dedicated.
rachel: thanks, nina. good repro path. :detective:
_review_notes: Slack thread: short messages, includes minimal curl snippet and canary logs. Focus on quantized KV packing + RoPE anchor drift during mid-generation system prompt reinsertion.
